purpose: Produce a stable cross-section master schema without altering source-supported legal meaning.

rules.name: Canonical schema projection
rules.description: All record types use the same top-level schema: identity, classification scope, hierarchy, text, unit, legal context, source, audit, normalization.

rules.name: Whitespace normalization
rules.description: Normalized display/legal text collapses source line breaks and repeated whitespace. Source raw text is retained separately.

rules.name: Hierarchy-marker cleanup
rules.description: Leading table indentation markers such as '-' or '---' are removed only from normalized display text, not from source raw text.

rules.name: Code normalization
rules.description: Dotted source code is retained and a compact alphanumeric code is materialized. No HS code is changed.

rules.name: Unit normalization
rules.description: A canonical unit enum (kg, carat, kg/unit) is derived while Vietnamese/English source units are preserved.

rules.name: Hierarchy materialization
rules.description: Parent, ancestors and children are materialized from the audited Phase-5 hierarchy.

rules.name: Legal context materialization
rules.description: Direct legal-note links are read from the Phase-6 graph; inherited legal context is derived from audited HS ancestors and stored separately from direct links.

rules.name: No semantic rewrite
rules.description: No translation, spelling repair, legal paraphrase or invented description is introduced by Phase 9.

rules.name: Source-verified transcription repair
rules.description: Final normalized display text may correct extraction/transcription artifacts only when confirmed against the rendered supplied source and an authoritative external publication. Raw/source snapshot fields are never rewritten.
